sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharm Trivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of complainant despite service of notice.
2. In terms of the F.I.R., a missing person report was lodged.

Subsequently, in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story she specifically stated that she was in love with the applicant however, nothing wrong was done to her, the tentative age of the victim is around 15-16 years.
Vishal Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.text: Vishal Verma vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that applicant is jail since 23.11.2023 however, he has no criminal history.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that victim has specifically stated that nothing wrong was done to her,
applicant in custody since 23.11.2023 having no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant- Vishal Verma be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.533 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) IPC and Section 3/4(2) POCSO Act and Section 3(1)da, 3(1)dha, 3(2)5A,
3(2)5 of SC/ST Act, Police Station Fardhan, District Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
